data.description:
## Context / Problem
Slice C1 (ticket 29a9-3cf7-3ded-42d8) recorded 27 below-seam ambient config/credential reads in the llm / workflow / grounding subsystem (llm/, grounding/, llm/workflow) as entries in `scripts/config_ownership_exceptions.LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS`. RP-04 is not complete while these ambient reads sit below the approved composition/credential/backend seams enforced by `scripts/check_config_ownership.py`. Parent: 075b-1479-dcb7-40ab.

Affected files (relative to `src/rebar/`):
  - `src/rebar/grounding/harness.py`
  - `src/rebar/grounding/oracle.py`
  - `src/rebar/grounding/resolve.py`
  - `src/rebar/llm/code_review/workflow_ops.py`
  - `src/rebar/llm/completion.py`
  - `src/rebar/llm/enrich_drain.py`
  - `src/rebar/llm/gate_context.py`
  - `src/rebar/llm/gate_source.py`
  - `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/__init__.py`
  - `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/det_floor.py`
  - `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/drift_floor.py`
  - `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/pin_health.py`
  - `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/sizing.py`
  - `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/workflow_ops.py`
  - `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/xcheck.py`
  - `src/rebar/llm/usage_log.py`
  - `src/rebar/llm/workflow/completion_banking.py`
  - `src/rebar/llm/workflow/criterion_preview.py`
  - `src/rebar/llm/workflow/executor.py`
  - `src/rebar/llm/workflow/gate_dispatch.py`
  - `src/rebar/llm/workflow/gate_ops.py`
  - `src/rebar/llm/workflow/interpreter.py`

## Outcome
Every below-seam read in the files above is either (a) CUT to compose through the approved seam that already assembles config — the operation snapshot (`rebar._operation_config.OperationSnapshot` / `compose_operation_snapshot`), a startup binding, or the provider-credential boundary — or (b) REGISTERED as an owned, non-legacy entry with an exact `path`+`symbol`+`rationale` for genuine test-only controls and protocol constants. Their `LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS` entries are removed. `python scripts/check_config_ownership.py` reports zero findings for these paths with those entries gone and no path-glob exception. The subsystem's behavioral suites stay green; redacted operation-snapshot fingerprints / provider-neutral outcomes are unchanged except recorded, justified deltas.

## Plan
1. For each below-seam read in the listed files, classify as cut-to-seam or register-owned; for cut-to-seam, thread the value from the composition seam rather than reading ambient `os.environ`/`os.getenv`/`load_config` below it.
2. Remove the corresponding entries for these files from `LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS` in `scripts/config_ownership_exceptions.py`.
3. Run `python scripts/check_config_ownership.py` and the subsystem behavioral suites (tests/unit/plan_review, tests/interfaces/store/test_llm_framework.py, grounding suites); keep green.

## Testing (RED -> GREEN)
- Held-out test `tests/scripts/test_llm_workflow_seam_clean_heldout.py` asserts `check_config_ownership.check(check_config_ownership.REPO_ROOT)` returns no finding string containing any of the listed paths, AND that `config_ownership_exceptions.LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS` contains zero entries whose `path` is one of the listed files. RED now (entries present + reads below seam).
- The subsystem behavioral suites (tests/unit/plan_review, tests/interfaces/store/test_llm_framework.py, grounding suites) stay green after the cutover — they are the correctness oracle the AST gate supplements.
- Redacted operation-snapshot fingerprints before/after are equal except recorded deltas.

## Compatibility / rollback
No stored ticket/event/binding format changes. A legacy facade is removed only after its focused suite passes; until then rollback selects the facade.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] No direct ambient config/credential read, backend reload, or configurable default remains below the approved seam in the 22 listed files; each is cut-to-seam or registered as an owned (non-legacy) entry with rationale.
- [ ] The `LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS` entries for these files are removed from `scripts/config_ownership_exceptions.py`, and `python scripts/check_config_ownership.py` passes with no path-glob exception (proven by the held-out `test_llm_workflow_seam_clean_heldout.py`).
- [ ] The subsystem behavioral suites (tests/unit/plan_review, tests/interfaces/store/test_llm_framework.py, grounding suites) pass after the cutover; redacted operation-snapshot fingerprints / provider-neutral outcomes are unchanged except recorded approved deltas.
